description: Use when the user gives you a video FILE on their computer (a screen recording .mov/.mp4/.webm, a Loom or QuickTime download) that you cannot watch. This server cannot read local files, so this tool returns the exact one-line curl command that uploads the file and prints the change list as Markdown; run it with your shell tool. The result lists every change asked for, with the words said, where on screen, how to check it, a screenshot link of that moment, and the timed transcript.

path.description: Path of the video file on the user's computer.

name: convert_local_video
title: Turn a video file on this computer into a change list
